Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the second essay. The umpires are out in the middle with the Pakistan Women players in a huddle near the boundary line. They disperse onto the field as Amy Hunter and Gaby Lewis stride out to open the innings. Sadia Iqbal will begin proceedings with the ball. Let's go...
... RUN CHASE ...

The Irish Women started off well but bowled too many freebies in the middle overs. Arlene Kelly was the pick of the bowlers with 2 for 27 in her spell. Laura Delany and Leah Paul chipped in with a wicket. The wicket is good for batting and the ball is coming off nicely on the bat. Ireland Women will have to bat well to chase this down but they had a massive collapse in their game against England. Pakistan Women have some good spinners in their ranks and this will test the batting of Ireland Women. We shall be back shortly with Ireland Women's reply. Don't go anywhere.

An OUTSTANDING HUNDRED by Muneeba Ali has taken Pakistan Women to 165 for 5 in their 20 overs. Having put into bat first, Javeria Khan and Muneeba Ali added 44 for the first wicket with Muneeba doing the bulk of the scoring. Pakistan Women lost back-to-back wickets as their skipper Bismah Maroof was gone soon after Javeria Khan's wicket was lost. Nida Dar joined Muneeba in the middle and the duo added 101 for the third wicket scoring runs all around the park. Muneeba Ali was dismissed for a terrific 102 off 68. Nida Dar perished in the final over for a handy 33. Ayesha Naseem hit a lusty blow at the end as Pakistan ended on a healthy total.

OUT! STUMPED! A wicket on the last ball of the inning! Arlene Kelly bowls this full and outside off, Ayesha Naseem looks to give the charge once again but does not connect this time. Mary Waldron collects the ball and whips the ball. Replays show the batter is short of the crease and Pakistan Women have a strong total on the board despite the late wickets.
Commentary.Howout: st Mary Waldron b Arlene Kelly

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! That clears the fence with ease! Arlene Kelly bowls this full and just outside the off stump and it is in Ayesha Naseem's hitting arc. She clears her front foot out of the way and thumps this over wide long off for a huge hit.
Short ball outside off. Aliya Riaz mistimes her pull into the vacant short mid on region and they take one.
Goes full and outside off, Aliya Riaz hits this uppishly towards long off for a couple of runs.
This is bowled on a good length and outside off. Aliya Riaz looks to hit through the line but gets beaten.

OUT! TIMBER! Arlene Kelly gets the other set batter back to the shed on the very next delivery! This is a full toss bowled at the stumps. Nida Dar steps across to the leg side and looks to pull this away but misses and watches her stumps get shattered! Pakistan Women are suddenly four wickets down and are not getting the finish they would have hoped for. Aliya Riaz makes her way out to the middle for the last five balls.

OUT! CAUGHT! That is the end of an extraordinary knock from Muneeba Ali! Leah Paul floats this one full and just outside off. Muneeba Ali charges down the wicket and looks to go leg side but gets a leading edge that goes high towards mid off. Arlene Kelly settles under this and takes a comfortable catch but there is applause all around the ground for Muneeba Ali as she walks off the field. Pakistan Women lose their third wicket but are in a good position here. Ayesha Naseem is the new batter out in the middle.
Commentary.Howout: c Arlene Kelly b Leah Paul

Commentary.Commentary: Short and wide outside off. Muneeba Ali makes room and slaps this over the infield towards deep point for a couple of runs.
WIDE! Bowls this short and going down leg. Muneeba Ali leaves this alone and is called wide.

FOUR! Muneeba Ali reaches her HUNDRED! Becomes the first Pakistan Women player to get to this landmark in T20 cricket! What an achievement from the opening batter! A full delivery bowled wide outside off. Muneeba Ali strokes this towards cover and a misfield by the fielder allows the ball to run away to the fence for four runs.
Floats this one full and outside the off stump. Nida Dar slog sweeps this towards deep square leg for a single.
This is short as well and outside off. Nida Dar mistimes her shot back towards the bowler.
This is short and outside the off stump. Muneeba Ali mistimes her pull to the left of the bowler and gets away with it. They take a single.
Bowls this one full and outside the leg stump. Nida Dar looks to sweep but does not connect. Gets hit on the pads and it will be a dot ball to end the over.
Slightly short and into the pads. Muneeba Ali pulls this towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! This has been smashed away! Eimear Richardson flights this full outside off. Muneeba Ali gets to the pitch of the ball and thumps this towards deep cover for four runs.
Full and outside off. Muneeba Ali looks to sweep and misses. Gets an inside edge onto her pads.
Eimear Richardson floats this full and outside off. Muneeba Ali hits this over the infield towards deep cover and takes another brace.
Eimear Richardson bowls this short and outside off. Muneeba Ali rocks back in the crease and pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Tosses this one full and on the pads. Muneeba Ali sweeps this towards deep square leg for a single and will keep strike.
This is full as well and outside leg. Muneeba Ali charges down the wicket and knocks this back to the bowler.

FOUR! Leah Paul should have had a wicket in this over! This is just short of the fielder in the deep! Muneeba Ali shimmies down to a full delivery bowled outside leg and whips the ball towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder can't get her hands on the ball and goes past her for four runs.
Full and outside leg. Muneeba Ali shimmies down the wicket and clips this towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
DROPPED! Leah Paul bowls this short and in line with the stumps. Nida Dar back away and hits this uppishly towards mid off. The fielder moves well but is unable to hold on to the ball.
WIDE! Flighted full and outside off but well beyond the tram line. The umpire calls this wide.
Leah Paul bowls this short and outside off. Nida Dar punches this towards extra cover.
FOUR! Poor delivery and Muneeba Ali is not the one to miss out! This is full and on the pads. Muneeba Ali sweeps this down to fine leg and collects four more runs.

FOUR! Muneeba Ali makes room this time and continues the onslaught! Arlene Kelly bowls this really full and just outside off. Muneeba Ali goes towards the leg side and digs this out over the point fielder fort four runs.
Continues to bowl full and in line with the stumps. Nida Dar sweeps this straight to square leg. A fumble allows them to take a run.
Full this time and wide outside off. Muneeba Ali knocks this past the point fielder into the deep for one.
This is short and wide outside off. Nida Dar slaps this towards deep cover-point for a single.
Arlene Kelly bowls this on a yorker length and outside the off stump. Muneeba Ali is unable to dig this one out and it goes into the leg side off the keeper. They take a bye.
Tosses this one full as well and outside leg. Muneeba Ali shimmies down the wicket and clips this towards deep square leg for one.
This is fired down leg on a fuller length. Muneeba Ali comes across the stumps and looks to sweep this fine but misses. The umpire says it is not a wide.
Wider outside off on a fuller length. Muneeba Ali slices this over deep point for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Muneeba Ali shows she has good footwork as well! Cara Murray floats this one full and outside the off pole. Muneeba Ali goes down the wicket and thumps this towards deep cover for four runs.
This is short and angled into the pads. Nida Dar misses out this time and mistimes her pull into the leg side for one.

SIX! Outstanding use of the feet and this is a maximum! Cara Murray flights this full and outside the off stump. Nida Dar shimmies down the wicket and thumps this over the wide long off boundary for six runs.
On a good length this time and angled into the pads. Nida Dar eases this down to long on and will keep strike with a single.
Continues to bowl full and outside the off stump. Muneeba Ali knocks this down to long off for a run.

FOUR! Muneeba Ali taking the attack to the opposition now and gets Pakistan Women to 100! This is full as well and wide outside off. Muneeba Ali gets well across the stumps and goes down on one knew. She sweeps this towards deep backward square leg for four more runs.
FOUR! Muneeba Ali holds her shape really well here and goes over the top! Laura Delany goes full and into the batter. Muneeba Ali makes room and lofts this towards long off for four runs.
A slower delivery bowled slightly back of a length and angling down leg. Nida Dar pulls this towards deep square leg for a single.
Laura Delany bowls from 'round the wicket and serves this full, angled into the pads. Muneeba Ali steps away and mistimes her shot towards long on for one.
Bangs this in short and wide outside off. Nida Dar goes on her toes and decides not to play at it. The umpire does not reckon it is a wide and Nida Dar does not look too pleased about it.
Bowls this full and into the stumps. Muneeba Ali looks to swing into the leg side but gets an inside edge onto her pads. The ball falls into the pitch and they steal a single.
Bowls this one back of a length and in line with the stumps. Nida Dar pulls this uppishly towards deep square leg for a single.
A low full toss bowled outside the off stump. Muneeba Ali back away once again but has to reach out and knocks this towards deep point for one.
Goes full once again and just outside off. Muneeba Ali looks to make room and knocks this towards mid off.
Orla Prendergast bowls this on a fuller length and outside the off stump. Nida Dar looks to dab this into the off side but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg for a single.
Floated on off. Muneeba Ali gets down and sweeps it hard to the deep square leg for a couple. FIFTY up for Muneeba Ali. Her first one in International Women's Cricket.
Full and on the leg. Nida Dar sweeps it to deep backward square leg for one.
FOUR! BANG! Tossed up just outside off. Nida Dar swings hard and lofts it wide of the long on fielder as the ball races to the fence for four.
Short and outside off, Nida Dar cuts it away to the deep extra cover region for a couple. Good running by the duo.
Tosses up outside off. Nida Dar goes for the sweep but misses.
Drifting on the pads. Muneeba Ali tucks it to deep backward square leg for one.
Flatter and outside off. Nida Dar guides it to point. A dot to end the over.
Flat and outside off. Nida Dar cuts it through extra cover region as the batters scampers for a brace.
Shortish, and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Full and on the stumps. Muneeba Ali advances and lofts it in the air. The ball falls in between mid-wicket and long on as the batters complete two.
Full and on off. Muneeba Ali uses her feet and drills it to mid-off.
Tossed up outside off. Nida Dar cuts it to deep point for one.

DRINKS! This has been a good start by Pakistan Women courtesy of Muneeba Ali and they will be looking to press their advantage after the break. They have lost a couple of crucial wickets but have enough firepower in their ranks to post a formidable total. Ireland Women have not been very disciplined as they have a couple of poor deliveries in their arsenal as well. They will want to restrict their opponents to a reasonable target and will need wickets for that.
Yorker length ball on off. Muneeba Ali digs it out and works it to the point region.
Full and angling down the leg. Muneeba Ali gets down to whip it across but misses and wears on the pad.
Length ball outside off. Nida Dar taps it to point for one.
Bowls it very full and just outside off. Muneeba Ali hits it to long on for one.
Full and outside off. Muneeba Ali drives it to covers.
Length ball on the middle and leg. Nida Dar pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Tossed up on off. Nida Dar drives it to long-off for one.
Full and on the stumps. Muneeba Ali sweeps it to short fine leg.
FOUR! Tossed up down the leg. Muneeba Ali gets down and sweeps it past the short fine leg as the ball races to the fence for four.
Full and on the stumps. Nida Dar sweeps it again to the fielder at deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Full and on the leg peg. Nida Dar gets down and sweeps it hard to the deep backward square leg region for a boundary.
Short and outside off. Muneeba Ali cuts it hard to deep extra covers for one.
Good length ball on off. Nida Dar defends it.
WIDE! Length ball down the leg. Left alone by Dar.
Nida Dar is the new batter out in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Bismah Maroof has to depart on a low score! Full and on off. Bismah Maroof chips it uppishly to mid-on. Arlene Kelly comes forward and takes a good low catch to dismiss the Pakistan Women's skipper for just 4. There was some speculation about the fairness of the catch but the third umpire has a good look at it and gives it OUT. Ireland Women have their second wicket and will they get a few more quickly?
Commentary.Howout: c Arlene Kelly b Laura Delany

Commentary.Commentary: Full and outside off. Muneeba Ali moves across and sweeps it slogs it aerially to deep backward square leg for one.
Good length delivery outside off. Bismah Maroof nudges it to point for a quick single.
Shortish on off. Muneeba Ali pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Full and on off. Bismah Maroof drives it to long on for one.
Tossed up. Slower and shorter outside off. Muneeba Ali looks to cut but misses. A dot to end the over.
Full and just outside off. Bismah Maroof sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
Short and outside off. Muneeba Ali cuts it to a point and a misfield allows her to take one.
Full and outside off. Bismah Maroof drives it to deep extra covers for one.
WIDE AGAIN! Dishes it full and down the leg. Bismah Maroof misses out on the sweep.
Tosses it outside off. Muneeba Ali pushes it cover-point for one.
WIDE! Floated again but outside the tramline this time. Muneeba Ali leaves it alone and the wide is given by the umpire.
Tossed up outside off. Muneeba Ali looks to cut it away but fails to connect.
Full and just outside off. Bismah Maroof steers it to point. Pakistan Women are 45 for the loss of one wicket after the Powerplay.
Length ball on the stumps. Muneeba Ali dabs it to the onside and takes a quick single.
Bismah Maroof makes her way out to the middle at number 3.

OUT! RUN OUT! Ireland Women finally get a breakthrough and it is Pakistan Women who have gifted it to them! Jane Maguire bowls this on a fuller length and just outside the off stump taking pace off the ball. Javeria Khan looks to sweep this away but misses and the ball falls into the off side off her body. He huge appeal from the bowler and the wicket-keeper but the umpire remains unmoved. Muneeba Ali calls her partner through for a quick run but Mary Waldron is quick to react from behind the wicket. She runs towards the ball and makes an underarm throw at the non-striker's end. They go upstairs to check and the Javeria Khan is short by a whisker. Pakistan Women lose their first wicket just before the Powerplay comes to an end.
Almost a yorker-length ball on the stumps. Javeria Khan digs it out and works it to the short fine leg off an inside edge.
Jane Maguire bowls this full and in line with the stumps. Muneeba Ali dabs this towards mid on for a quick single.
Full and wide outside off. Muneeba Ali slices it to deep backward point for one.
Good length on off. Muneeba Ali cuts it to backward point for one.
Full and just outside the leg stump. Muneeba Ali goes for the heave but fails to connect. The keepers do not collect it cleanly. Ball runs down to the fine leg region as the batters take 2 byes.
FOUR! BANG! Slower ball, full toss, and just outside off. Muneeba Ali relishes it and hits it down the ground past the bowler for a boundary.
Very full and on the off stump. Muneeba Ali drills it back at Kelly.
Full and angling into the middle and leg. Javeria Khan works it wide of mid-on for one.
Full and outside off. Muneeba Ali slices it over the backward point region for a single.
Short again and Muneeba Ali thrashes it to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! BANG! Shortish and down the leg. Muneeba Ali goes back and helps it away over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary. Easy pickings.
Tossed up on off. Muneeba Ali prods forward and pushes it to covers.
Shortish and on off. Javeria Khan goes back and cuts it to cover-point for one.
Faction too short on off. Muneeba Ali goes back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and outside off, Javeria Khan guides it to short third for one.
Back of a length ball just outside off. Javeria Khan drops it into the onside and takes a single.
Full and outside off. Muneeba Ali slices it uppishly to third man for one.
FOUR! Back of a length ball on the pads. Muneeba Ali tucks it off her gloves as the ball runs away to the fine leg fence for four.
LEG BYE! On a length angling in. Javeria Khan tucks it off her pads to fine leg and runs across for a leg bye.
Length ball outside off. Muneeba Ali guides it down to third man for one.
Full and outside off. Muneeba Ali drives it uppishly through the backward point region for a couple.
Back to bowling on a good length and outside off. Javeria Khan defends this solidly back towards the bowler.
Goes fuller this time and wide outside off. Muneeba Ali strokes this beautifully towards deep cover-point but it will only be a single.
WIDE! Continues to bowl on a good length but going down leg. Muneeba Ali misses and the umpire indicates this is wide.
On a good length and outside the off stump. Muneeba Ali knocks this towards mid off.

FOUR! Muneeba Ali plays this one really late and delicately guides it for a boundary! Jane Maguire bowls this just outside the off pole on a good length. Muneeba Ali opens the face of her bat and the ball races towards the third man fence for four runs.
Bowls this on a good length and just outside the off stump. Javeria Khan pushes at this and gets an inside edge to the right of mid-wicket for a quick run.
Jane Maguire starts with a short ball bowled wide outside off. Javeria Khan cuts this towards point.
Jane Maguire will share the attack and bowl from the other end.
On a good length once again but straying onto the pads. Javeria Khan clips this towards square leg and takes one to get off the mark.
This is on a good length and angled into the stumps. Javeria Khan looks to flick this leg side but gets a leading edge over the bowler's head towards mid off.
BEATEN! Orla Prendergast bowls this on a good length and outside the off stump. Javeria Khan feels for the ball as it zips past her outside edge.
Delivers this on a good length and outside the off stump. Muneeba Ali dabs this into the off side and sets off for a quick single.
WIDE! Strays down leg once again and Muneeba Ali misses her flick this time. The umpire calls this one wide though.
FOUR! Orla Prendergast gets her line wrong and is punished! This is bowled on a good length and going down leg. Muneeba Ali clips this towards fine leg for four runs to open her account.
Orla Prendergast begins with a good length delivered on an off-stump line. Muneeba Ali blocks this back towards the bowler.

Now that the prematch formalities are done, we can get the game underway. The umpires make their way out to the middle and the Ireland Women's players are in a huddle beyond the boundary line before taking their respective positions on the field. Javeria Khan and Muneeba Ali will open the innings for Pakistan Women and they will want to get off to a good start. Some of the players decide to take a knee in support of the BLM movement. Orla Prendergast has the new ball in her hand and will begin proceedings. Let's play...

We are moments away from the start of the game but first, we will have the umpires and the two sets of players to line up for the national anthems. It will be Ireland's national anthem first followed by the national anthem of Pakistan.

Ireland Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Amy Hunter, Gaby Lewis, Orla Prendergast, Laura Delany (C), Eimear Richardson, Louise Little, Mary Waldron (WK), Leah Paul, Arlene Kelly, Cara Murray, Jane Maguire.

Pakistan Women (Playing XI) - Muneeba Ali (WK), Javeria Khan, Bismah Maroof (C), Nida Dar, Ayesha Naseem, Aliya Riaz, Fatima Sana, Aiman Anwer, Tuba Hassan (In place of Sidra Ameen), Nashra Sandhu, Sadia Iqbal.
TOSS - The captains are out in the middle. The coin is flipped into the air and lands in favor of Ireland Women. They have elected to BOWL first.

Ireland Women, on the other hand, gave England Women a tough fight in the opening encounter. Their batting failed to get enough on the board against England. Gaby Lewis was the standout batter with 36 off 37 balls. Their bowlers kept them in the game getting wickets at regular intervals. Alice Capsey took the game away from them with a swashbuckling half century off just 20 odd deliveries. Cara Murray was the pick of the bowlers for Ireland with 3 for 15 in her 3-over spell. Arlene Kelly and Orla Prendergast supported Murray well but they did not have enough runs to defend. Who will come out on top in this clash? We shall find out together. Stay tuned as we bring you the toss and team news shortly.

Pakistan Women played a good game of cricket against arch rivals India. They posted a very good total on the board making 149 in their innings. Skipper Bismah Maroof led from the front with a brilliant 68 and was well supported by the young batter Ayesha Naseem who made a quick-fire 43* off 25. They kept the Indian Women under pressure for most part of the game but a 4th wicket stand Richa Ghosh and Jemimah Rodrigues took the game away from them eventually losing it by 7 wickets with an over to spare. Nashra Sandhu was excellent with the ball for Pakistan Women but lacked support from the other end. The Women in Green will look to put up a good show and get their first win of the tournament.

Hello and a warm welcome to Game 10 in the Women’s T20 World Cup. The Pakistan Women are squaring off against Ireland Women from the Newlands in Cape Town. Both the teams lost their respective opening fixtures and will look to get back into winning ways.
...MATCHDAY...

With all teams having played at least one game in the competition so far, the tone has been nicely set for the nations participating the in the Women's T20 World Cup 2023 to fight hard and push for the coveted semi-final slots. The spotlight is now on match number 10 where Ireland Women will lock horns against Pakistan Women at the Newlands Cricket Ground in Cape Town with both teams coming into this game on the back of disappointing defeats in the opening fixture. Ireland Women came into the first game with an underdog status and as fan favorites having beaten of formidable Australia Women's side in the warm-up game prior to the tournament. They started strongly against England Women reaching 80 for the loss of two wickets in the first 12 overs but a batting collapse which saw them lose 8 wickets for 25 runs in 35 balls resulted in them putting up an under-par total. They did manage to put some pressure on the opposition batters when they came out to defend the target but in the end, lost by 4 wickets and with 34 balls to spare. Gaby Lewis played the role of an anchor well up the order but did not get enough support from the remaining batters around her. Amy Hunter, Orla Prendergast, and Laura Delany all got off to decent starts but could not carry on and they were eventually bowled out in 18.2 overs. Cara Murray gave her side a glimmer of hope by claiming three wickets in her three overs with Orla Prendergast and Arlene Kelly chipping in with one each. Jane Maguire and Eimear Richardson proved to be quite expensive and will need to hold their nerves if they are to do much better with the ball in this match. Pakistan Women played their first game against arch-rivals India Women and despite a strong batting performance, they lost by 7 wickets and with 6 balls remaining. Having elected to bat first they lost their openers Muneeba Ali and Javeria Khan for low scores with Nida Dar and Sidra Nawaz not making much of an impact either. A crucial partnership between the skipper Bismah Maroof who scored a lovely half-century and Ayesha Naseem who played an attacking cameo, helped them post a decent total on the board. Nashra Sandhu and Sadia Iqbal were outstanding with the ball as they bowled with discipline claiming 2 and 1 wicket each and did not allow the opposition to score freely against them. Fatima Sana, Aiman Anwer, and Nida Dar bore the brunt of India Women's strong batting lineup as they were taken for plenty and therefore were unable to defend the target. Both teams have their work cut out if they are to progress further in this competition and need to be at their best to return to winning ways as a loss for them at this stage would prove to be devastating for their World Cup campaign. The weather is expected to be nice and cool for a good game of cricket but dew could be a factor as the game progresses under the lights due to the high humidity around the ground. Will Pakistan Women be able to overcome the disappointment of losing the last game and register a crucial win? Or will Ireland Women pull of an upset that everyone is looking forward to? We will find out soon.
